# Feature: Integration verification — full build & test suite (F7)

## Goal

Green release gate in the composed launcher for its default preset.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `npm run build` succeeds in the launcher distribution with its default preset (`configs/full.json` = all 8 games + Gym) producing `dist/` with the `/Tableau-Card-Engine/` base.
2. `npm test` full suite passes in the launcher distribution with the default preset (release gate; unit + build minimum before push per AGENTS.md).
3. `npm run package` (Electron binary) succeeds from the launcher distribution.
4. No regressions vs pre-refactor green state (same tests passing as before the refactor).

## Key Files

- Root configs, `configs/**`, tests/**

## Dependencies

- Depends on F4 (CG-0MTRO72W5003ECAK) and F5 (CG-0MTRO77XA006YZZC) — the launcher must be fully assembled.

# Feature: Per-game repos use `src/` source root with alias-based core imports (Option C)

Part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17. Follow-on refinement of the F4 game-repo scaffold.

## Goal

As a game developer I can clone a `tce-<game>` repo and find that game's source at the repo-root `src/` directory, with every engine import going through the `@core-engine/*` (and `@card-system/*`, `@rule-engine/*`, `@ui/*`, `@ai/*`) path aliases, so that the repo has an idiomatic layout and does not rely on the `src -> ../tableau-card-engine-core/src` compatibility symlink or fragile `../../src/**` relative imports.

## Problem

The F4 scaffold keeps the game nested at `example-games/<game>/` and creates a `src` symlink into the core checkout. 319 game-source imports use `../../src/**` and only resolve because the game sits exactly two levels below the repo root. This is fragile, non-idiomatic, and blocks moving the game source to `src/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Decision record exists (child C1) fixing the per-game layout (`src/**` or `src/<game>/**`), how `scripts/`, `example-games/gym`, shared assets and test helpers resolve from `src/`, and the `scenePath` contract for monorepo-local vs sibling-repo contexts.
2. A scaffolded `tce-<game>` checkout has its game source under `src/`, contains no `src` symlink to the core, and `npm run build` + `npm test -- --project unit` succeed.
3. No game-repo source or test imports core through a `../../src/**` relative specifier; a test/lint guards this invariant.
4. The launcher (`configs/*.json` presets + `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts`) resolves game scenes in both the flat monorepo (`example-games/<game>/…`) and the `src/` sibling game-repo layout; the 1-game (`solo`) and all-games (`full`) presets both build.
5. `docs/dev/multi-repo-architecture.md`, `docs/DEVELOPER.md` and `README.md` describe the new per-game layout.

## Constraints

- The monorepo/launcher flat layout may stay `example-games/<game>/`; only per-game repos change to `src/`. C1 may override this if a uniform layout proves cleaner.
- The producer gate on F4 still applies: no GitHub repo creation or push.
- Engine imports must resolve via `tsconfig.json` `paths` + Vite `resolve.alias`; no new npm publication of the engine.

## Children

- C1 Decide per-game `src/` layout, import contract and preset resolution
- C2 Codemod game source + tests off `../../src/**` to engine aliases
- C3 Extraction/scaffold/repo-layout emit the `src/` layout
- C4 Discovery plugin + launcher presets resolve `src/` sibling layouts
- C5 Update game docs and verify per-game tsc/build/unit
data.title: F9: Per-game repos use src/ source root with alias-based core imports (Option C)

# Task C5: Update game docs and verify per-game tsc/build/unit

Parent: F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME (part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17).
Depends on: C2, C3, C4.

## Goal

As a game developer the per-game documentation matches the new `src/` layout and a scaffolded game repo is proven to type-check, build and pass its unit suite.

## Scope

1. Update developer-facing docs for the per-game `src/` layout: `docs/dev/multi-repo-architecture.md`, `docs/DEVELOPER.md`, `README.md`, and the F9 decision record's "how to" section.
2. Update any per-game docs/`README` snippets that show `example-games/<game>/…` paths (respecting each game's own docs).
3. Run the per-game gate on a scaffolded checkout for a representative sample (at minimum golf and main-street; ideally all 8): `tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, `npm test -- --project unit`.
4. Record evidence (command + result) on this work item and on F9.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Docs describe the `src/` layout and the alias import contract with copy-paste commands.
2. `tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build` and `npm test -- --project unit` pass for golf and main-street from a scaffolded checkout with no other games on disk.
3. Evidence table (game × command × result) recorded on the work item.
4. No remaining developer docs instruct readers to use the removed `src` symlink or `../../src/**` imports.

## Notes

- Full browser/E2E suites are not required here (per AGENTS.md quality gates); the launcher full suite re-run is F7's responsibility once F9 lands.

# Task C2: Codemod game source + tests off `../../src/**` to engine aliases

Parent: F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME (part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17).
Depends on: C1 (layout + import contract).

## Goal

As a game developer my game repo imports the engine only through the agreed aliases, so the `src -> core/src` compatibility symlink can be removed and imports no longer depend on directory depth.

## Baseline

- 319 `../../src/**` imports across game source (`example-games/<game>/**`).
- Game tests (`tests/<game>/**`) additionally reference the game tree and `../../src/**`.
- Other root-relative specifiers to handle per the C1 contract: `../../scripts/**` (replay-adapter framework), `../../example-games/gym/**`, `../../tests/helpers/**`, and shared `public/**` if applicable.

## Scope

1. Write a deterministic codemod (script + tests) that rewrites the deep-relative specifiers to the agreed alias form for every game (golf, beleaguered-castle, blackjack, sushi-go, feudalism, lost-cities, main-street, coloretto) and for game-owned tests.
2. Cover `.ts` and `.tsx` (and any other import-bearing) game files.
3. Leave the monorepo's own `example-games/<game>` tree valid if the monorepo keeps the flat layout — the codemod must produce imports that resolve in a `src/`-layout game repo (aliases resolve in both contexts via tsconfig/vite).
4. Add a guard test asserting no game-repo source/test uses a `../../src/**` specifier to reach the engine.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Codemod committed with unit tests (idempotent; reports counts before/after).
2. Running it leaves zero `../../src/**` engine imports in game source and game tests.
3. `tsc --noEmit` and `npm test -- --project unit` pass for at least golf and main-street in a composed checkout.
4. Guard test fails on a deliberately introduced `../../src/**` import.

## Key Files

- `scripts/**` (new codemod)
- `example-games/<game>/**`
- `tests/<game>/**`
data.title: C2: Codemod game source + tests off ../../src/** to engine aliases

# Task C3: Extraction/scaffold/repo-layout emit the `src/` layout

Parent: F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME (part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17).
Depends on: C1 (layout + import contract).

## Goal

As a distribution/engine maintainer I can run the extraction + scaffold so a `tce-<game>` checkout places the game source at `src/` per the C1 decision and does not create a `src` symlink into the core.

## Scope

1. `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` — update each game's `paths` (and any asset/path fields) to the agreed `src/` layout so extraction produces the new tree.
2. `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts` — stop emitting the `src -> core/src` symlink; place/repoint the game tree at `src/`; adjust `configs/game.json`, `tsconfig.json` include/exclude, and `vite.config.ts` if needed; keep the remaining symlinks required by C1 (`scripts`, `example-games/gym`, `tests/helpers`, `core`, shared assets) or replace them per the contract.
3. Update the scaffold unit tests (`tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts`) to assert the new layout and the absence of the `src` symlink.
4. Verify `scripts/extract-repos.sh --dry-run --target <game>` and a real scaffold for golf and main-street produce the `src/` layout.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `repo-layout.json` and `game-repo-scaffold.ts` implement the C1 layout; scaffold unit tests updated and green.
2. A scaffolded golf (and main-street) checkout has game source under `src/` and no `src` symlink; `tsc --noEmit` + `npm run build` succeed.
3. Extraction history preservation is unchanged (still via `git filter-repo`; counts recorded).
4. `docs/dev/multi-repo-architecture.md` §5 updated to describe the emitted layout.

## Key Files

- `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json`
- `scripts/extract-repos.sh`
- `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts`
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts`, `tests/scripts/extract-repos.test.ts`
data.title: C3: Extraction/scaffold/repo-layout emit the src/ layout

# Task C4: Discovery plugin + launcher presets resolve `src/` sibling layouts

Parent: F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME (part of epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17).
Depends on: C1 (scenePath contract).

## Goal

As a distribution builder the launcher resolves a game's scene whether the game is in the flat monorepo (`example-games/<game>/…`) or in a `src/`-layout sibling repo (`../tce-<game>/src/…`), so `npm run build` works for the `solo` (1 game) and `full` (all games) presets after the layout change.

## Scope

1. Implement the C1 `scenePath` contract in `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts` (`discoverGames`, local vs sibling resolution) and `configs/*.json` presets (`full`, `solo`, `arcade`, `deluxe`, `core-only`).
2. Keep `core-only` (Gym, no games) working.
3. Game repos keep their own `configs/game.json` valid for the `src/` local layout (coordinate with C3).
4. Update the plugin unit tests (`tests/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.test.ts`) with a `src/`-layout sibling fixture and an error case for a missing scene.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Plugin resolves both flat-monorepo and `src/` sibling layouts; unit tests green.
2. `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/solo.json npm run build` and `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/full.json npm run build` succeed in the launcher against composed siblings; the selector enumerates exactly the configured games.
3. `GAMES_CONFIG=configs/core-only.json npm run build` still succeeds (Gym only).
4. Fail-fast, actionable error when a configured sibling scene is absent.

## Key Files

- `scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts`
- `configs/*.json`
- `tests/scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.test.ts`
data.title: C4: Discovery plugin + launcher presets resolve src/ sibling layouts
